Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
